brief:
A 15-year-old Palestinian boy, Ezzedine al-Lahalia, reunited with his family after spending a month in Israeli detention, Al-Monitor reported. He appeared visibly affected by the embrace from his mother as he emerged in an oversized grey prison jumpsuit, according to witnesses at his release.

The circumstances of his detention and the charges he faced were not immediately detailed in available reports.
dek: Looking tiny in his adult-size grey prison jumpsuit, 15-year-old Palestinian Ezzedine al-Lahalia appeared stunned as his mother embraced him after a month in an Israeli jail.
title: Israeli jail releases Palestinian teenager after month of detention
